title: Not durable.
text:
Not durable.. These are holding up really well in the freezer, are significantly better than other freezer containers. It really doesn't let much air out... I would say you would need an air extractor to get that. They are a perfect size for a dozen muffins!

Update: It is 3/5/18 and I have had to throw one lid away. It broke in the freezer. I have been using them most every day, but they are not standing up to daily use.
